<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sa_pattern"><sa_pattern action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><ci_type>cmdb_ci_appl_generic</ci_type><cpattern_type>2</cpattern_type><description/><directory>false</directory><enforce_proc_classy>false</enforce_proc_classy><invoke_per_account>false</invoke_per_account><metadata_id>01fbda33c3f93e50982a7d0ed401310f</metadata_id><name>Get Object Id for QEMU Windows Server</name><ndl>library {
	name = "Get Object Id for QEMU Windows Server"
	id = "01fbda33c3f93e50982a7d0ed401310f"
	description = "Get Object Id for QEMU Windows Server"
	step {
		name = "Set object_id"
		if {
			condition = contains {
				get_attr {"Win32_ComputerSystem[*].Manufacturer"}
				"QEMU"
			}
			on_true = transform {
				src_table_name = "cmdb_ci_win_server"
				target_table_name = "cmdb_ci_win_server"
				operation {
					set_field {
						field_name = "object_id"
						value = get_attr {"Win32_ComputerSystemProduct[*].UUID"}
					}
					set_field {
						field_name = "virtual"
						value = "true"
					}
				}
			}
			on_false = nop {}
		}
	}
}
</ndl><parent/><serverless>false</serverless><source/><sys_class_name>sa_pattern</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>karel.benes</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-12-20 19:49:37</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>01fbda33c3f93e50982a7d0ed401310f</sys_id><sys_mod_count>6</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Get Object Id for QEMU Windows Server</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sa_pattern_01fbda33c3f93e50982a7d0ed401310f</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>karel.benes</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-01-19 20:45:42</sys_updated_on><version/></sa_pattern></record_update>
